purpose: Descriptive full-cloud validation of the already completed five-epoch S8 feasibility pilot. This is not confirmatory evidence and cannot authorize confirmatory training or test evaluation.
checkpoint_rule: Use the pilot best.pth selected by the already locked earliest-best fixed-crop validation Part-IoU rule; do not select another epoch using full-cloud metrics.

evaluation.topology: S8 label-free row-softmax 4096->1024->256; support_k=8; kNN levels k0=16,k1=16,k2=12
evaluation.precision: BF16 autocast; topology, mass, and metric accumulation FP32
evaluation.coverage: Every validation point receives exactly one prediction per frozen vote seed; padding is excluded.

interpretation_limits.decision_after_result: Any confirmatory S8 work requires a separate post-pilot decision and separately hashed confirmatory preregistration before training. This artifact does not authorize it.
